text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spikes in 429s and high tail-latency on embeddings-async.us-west1 (rate=~6k req/s, 30m) -- auto-pager triggered.

alex (oncall-sre): i'm on it, paging pj. seeing lots of small payloads hitting batch-embeddings with rotated tokens. looks like scraper farm.

marta (eng-runtime): throwing visibility: kv-cache miss rate is 85% for embeddings index, cache thrash + disk spill. leaderboard shows top 20 IPs from a handful of ASNs.

josh (eng-platform): can we shadow route to lower-priority pool or throttle at edge? prefer not to kill all embeddings for prod customers.

alex (oncall-sre): immediate plan: 1) apply per-token soft quota for embeddings per-token/per-minute 2) disable batch-embeddings endpoint for 10m (surgical) 3) add WAF challenge for suspicious ASN ranges.

priya (support): flagged two paying customers reporting 5xx/timeout errors. prepping customer-impact notes. which endpoints are affected exactly?

marta (eng-runtime): root hit: /v1/embeddings/batch-async and the realtime embeddings stream. single-token requests are being batched into huge QPS causing backend saturation.

alex (oncall-sre): executed: `rbac apply rate-limit --service embeddings --scope tenant --rate 60rpm` (temp). also applied quota slice: `quota.set tenant_slice=1000 tokens/min` for new tokens.

deploy-bot: deploy 0f3a9c -> prod (edge-rate-limiter): success in us-west1 (6 nodes).

carlos (sec): i've pushed a WAF rule (ID wf-8732) to issue `challenge` (captcha) for UA/ASN patterns and known bot headers. also adding header fingerprint blocklist.

josh (eng-platform): added geo-blackhole for traffic from ASN 39874/61500 in edge firewall (drop). confirming logs show reduced connection attempts from those ranges.

sam (product): are we sure captcha won't impact legit users? need to surface to support and product. priya, prepping a KB?

priya (support): yes, drafting a canned response and priority ticket template. will notify affected customers with estimated ETA 30m.

marta (eng-runtime): monitoring: KV-cache miss rate dropped to 42% after initial throttles. p95 latency down from 1.6s -> 480ms. 429s still present but tail is decreasing.

alex (oncall-sre): adding additional edge rate-limit: `limit_by=ip,user_agent` and enable `burst=20` to avoid harming normal spikes. leaving batch endpoint disabled until we confirm stability.

carlos (sec): note: attackers are using token-stuffing across many tenant tokens; need token issuance audit. also recommend blocking token reuse patterns and raising token rotation alerts.

josh (eng-platform): started a short-lived token blacklist for tokens seen >500 req/min. propagated to edge via config push.

priya (support): initial customer impact: 4 mid-market customers experienced degraded embeddings (timeouts) ~start 2934567600. two have open support threads, flagged for SE touch.

sam (product): we'll offer credits if SLA breached. product OK with temporary mitigations. need postmortem checklist after.

marta (eng-runtime): suggestion: re-enable batch-embeddings in degraded mode (max_batch=16, accept_sampling=true) to reduce kv-cache churn. can roll in 5m if stable.

alex (oncall-sre): approved. marta, do the rollout. josh, keep WAF challenge active 30m. carlos, gather bot fingerprints for long-term rule.

marta (eng-runtime): rolling config: `embeddings.batch.max=16` -> applied to us-west pool.

monitoring-bot: us-west1 embeddings-async p95 latency: 480ms (down from 1.6s), 429 rate: 240/min (down from 2.1k/min).

alex (oncall-sre): traffic shaping seems effective. leaving batch endpoint disabled for extra 15m to observe. keeping per-tenant quota until midnight UTC.

carlos (sec): saving WAF rule set + fingerprints to sec repo: link: https://redwood.internal/sec/waf/rules/wf-8732 (internal)

priya (support): sent interim notice to the two impacted customers with rollback steps and ETA.

sam (product): will brief account teams; cc'ing sales on credits.

alex (oncall-sre): handoff to overnight oncall @alex will remain assigned for 1hr, then pass to @josh. if 429s creep above 500/min, escalate to incident commander.

josh (eng-platform): ack, will monitor overnight and prepare postmortem template.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (2934567999): mitigations holding. continue to monitor for 2h, then start RCA.

alex (oncall-sre): final note: root cause appears to be a scraper farm using token rotation + small payloads causing KV cache thrash on embeddings index. long-term fixes: token abuse detection, per-tenant adaptive batching, improved edge fingerprinting, and stricter default quotas for batch endpoints.

marta (eng-runtime): agree. I'll open an RFC for adaptive batching and cache isolation.

priya (support): will prepare customer-impact summary for postmortem.

josh (eng-platform): handing off active monitoring to @josh (overnight). closing live mitigation phase.

deploy-bot: revert: batch-embeddings disabled flag set -> false (deferred) -- manual confirmation needed before full re-enable.

alex (oncall-sre): thanks everyone. filing pager record and tagging for postmortem. :thumbsup:
